sources: docs/proposals/vrm-author-cli/parameters.md (Textures and MToon: material shading computes toony and shift)

inputClasses: project material object with MToon fields (face_skin role in the suite)

parameterRanges.shadowEnd: number; resulting shift must lie in [-1, 1]

invariants: toony = 1 - width/2 and shift = toony - 1 - shadowEnd are written to the material; illegal factors are rejected, never clamped
dry run plans the two pointer edits with the same planHash as the applied edit and does not bump the revision
out-of-range solve is gateFailed with the revision unchanged; terminatorWidth 3 is invalidRequest; an unknown material is OBJECT_NOT_FOUND; a stale expectedRevision is a conflict
the 13 role defaults satisfy every must/should material rule of the pinned profile and the (-1, 0) edge case solves
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass
the four legal corners of the (shadowEnd, terminatorWidth) region solve to toony in [0, 1] and shift in [-1, 1]
every one of the 13 role defaults round-trips: the role's declared (toony, shift) derives a (shadowEnd, terminatorWidth) that solves back to that role's own factors
excluded: guaranteed pixel appearance (factors are lighting goals)

A report envelope claiming every MaterialsPackTests test passed (executed 9, failed 0, exit 0) whose oracleHashes name a Tests/VRMAuthorKitTests/Materials/MaterialsPackTests.swift other than the pinned one. The runner's report-acceptance path must refuse it before any assertion runs.

visual.adjudication: different-family judge, zero false accepts on the 12-case calibration set (verification.md §5)

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: The 22-asset / 18-family development corpus is calibration data for profile v0.1.0; every eligible family must pass with per-family denominators reported. A sealed holdout and evaluation budget are Stage C (verification.md §6).
evidencePolicy.corpusApplicabilityRecord: material shading is body-independent: its input class is a project material object with MToon fields, so partitioning by body family is pseudo-precision for any style. The parameter space is covered instead by a fixture sweep over the four legal corners of the (shadowEnd, terminatorWidth) region, and the role dimension by a per-role round trip: each of the 13 role defaults the template pack declares derives a (shadowEnd, terminatorWidth) that solves back to that role's own factors. Those 13 defaults take three distinct (toony, shift) pairs, so the round trip covers three configurations, not 13, and it does not assert which pair a role maps to. Per-role coverage proper is testRoleDefaultsSatisfyEveryMaterialRuleOfThePinnedProfile, which checks every role against every material rule of the attached profile. The profile declares no per-role shading values; the defaults are the template pack's. Recorded by the acceptance author; the independent reviewer confirms or overturns this in reviewReceipt.
